title: Ms. Demille
tagline: AI -powered assistants for professional creators. Get ready for your close-up
description:
This project provides NFT access passes to independent production companies and musicians who don't have day-to-day teams. Each pass unlocks the ability to create personalized models that can help you do everything from finding a film crew to getting detailed CRM assistance.

The main problem is small and medium creative businesses need more resources to be competitive. The potential AI-powered assistants have to improve workflow and add an army of employees is incredible and will give many professional creators a fighting chance to bring their vision to life.
how_its_made:
This is a two-sided marketplace.

Algovera and Monkey Learn were used to create custom models. 
Users will log in with web3auth to their SAFE wallet.
NFTs are deployed on Polygon via an ERC 1155 contract.
Local communities will be made inside of the Lens Ecosystem allowing freelancers to verify their talent and skills and receive payment also through crypto.

The goal is to make a multi-token payment system including GHO, MATIC, ETHEREUM and others.
